venue.name: Chinese Consolidated Benevolent Association Building and Chinese Public School
venue.description: A heritage building in Victoria associated with the Chinese Consolidated Benevolent Association and the Chinese Public School. No website owned or operated by the association or the school could be found, so nothing about visits, tours, group programs, hours or prices could be verified from a first-party source. The address recorded in the source tracker, heritagebc.ca, is a third-party heritage advocacy directory rather than this venue's own domain, and directory listings are not treated as sources by this pipeline. Everything a group leader needs here has to come from a phone call.
